preconditions.description: The number of vertices in the tree is an integer between 2 and 500,000 inclusive.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= x <= n and 1 <= y <= n for x, y in edges) and len(edges) == n - 1
preconditions.description: The edges form an undirected tree with n vertices, where each edge connects two vertices in the range [1, n].
The input edges form a connected acyclic graph (tree) with n vertices.
The root of the tree is vertex 1.

postconditions.expression: t == max(depth[leaf] for leaf in leaves)
postconditions.description: The output t is the maximum depth of any leaf from the root, where depth[leaf] is the number of edges in the unique path from leaf to root.
The output t is a non-negative integer representing the minimal time required for all ants to reach the root.
